name: Boon of Fate
summary: +1 to any ability (max 30); add or subtract 2d4 on a D20 Test within 60 feet, recharging on Initiative or a rest.

benefits.name: Improve Fate
benefits.summary: When a creature within 60 ft (or you) succeeds or fails a D20 Test, roll 2d4 as a bonus or penalty to it.
benefits.text: When you or another creature within 60 feet of you succeeds or fails on a D20 Test, you can roll 2d4 and apply the total as a bonus or a penalty to that d20 roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.
